Method of Attack: Ryuk ransomware encrypts files on infected computers and appends .RYK extension; creates ransom note RyukReadMe.html in every folder
TrickBot malware harvests data including passwords, files, and cookies from compromised computers and spreads laterally through network; opens reverse shell to Ryuk operators
Emotet Trojan spreads TrickBot via phishing emails
Impacted Systems: Epiq Global's network and computers across 80 global offices
Attack Vector: TrickBot infection leading to Ryuk deployment
